title: Welcome to UVtools v7.0.0!
message:
UVtools v7.0.0 is one of the biggest releases in the project's six-year history, introducing a new **GPU-accelerated 3D viewer**, advanced analysis tools and many other improvements.

Much of v7 was accelerated with the help of **multiple AI coding agents**, allowing development to move much faster. They still require significant review, testing, supervision and iteration — and their subscriptions, usage and token costs are paid personally by me.

UVtools remains **free and open source**, with **no ads, tracking or telemetry**. Sponsorship helps cover development costs and directly contributes to keeping UVtools and my other open-source projects actively maintained and moving forward. ❤️

📖 **The full v7.0.0 announcement will open in your browser after this dialog is closed**, with more details about what's new, how the project has grown, and the reality of sustaining open-source development.
